newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Jakarta rocked by earthquake, no damage reported.
newsitem.headline: Jakarta rocked by earthquake, no damage reported.

text.p: The Indonesian capital Jakarta was rocked by an earthquake on Monday afternoon, sending people scurrying out of high-rise buildings.
Office workers gathered on the streets after the tremor shook the city at about 3:10 p.m. (0810 GMT). There were no immediate reports of casualties or damage.
"Things were really swaying out here," said a guest staying in an upper floor of the Mandarin Oriental Hotel.
He said people rushed out of the hotel building but there was no damage.
There was no word on the intensity of the earthquake, with officials at the meteorological department not immediately available for comment.
The Indonesian archipelago is regularly hit by earthquakes.
